observations.enderchest: Observed empty 27-slot Ender Chest and SDK-closed. Reopened; ordinary-click deposited the named Efficiency I wooden pickaxe in slot0 and two lapis in slot26. SDK closure retained contents: player counts two pickaxes, zero lapis. Opened a second nearby Ender Chest source; Shift-click recovered the named pickaxe and ordinary-click recovered both lapis. Tooltip retained name and Efficiency I, and player counts returned to three total pickaxes/two lapis.
observations.ender_permission: Deposited one raw beef in slot26. Revoked the example source permission by temporarily de-opping the tester. One expected denial closed the view and retired its ticket. Player beef count zero. Restored the previous operator status and reopened the first source; the one raw beef remained.
observations.ender_source_removal: While viewing the retained beef, removed only the first test Ender Chest block. One expected denial closed the view. Reopening the second Ender Chest still showed the beef; Shift-click recovered it and read-only player count was one. Native X closed and the first test block was recreated with keep.
observations.barrel: Observed native Barrel title and 27 slots. Shift-click deposited three iron ingots in slot0, ordinary-click deposited six stone in slot26. SDK-closed, read-only player counts zero for both. Reopening retained both stacks. Shift-click withdrew six stone, ordinary-click withdrew three ingots; exact player counts six and three.
observations.barrel_disconnect: Deposited the named Efficiency I pickaxe in the barrel. A deliberate server kick disconnected the sole tester while the view was active; zero SDK tickets remained. Rejoined with two pickaxes in player inventory, reopened the barrel and observed the stored name/enchantment. Shift-click recovered the pickaxe, count returned to three, and native Escape closed normally.
observations.wrong_source: Requested barrel against a nearby Ender Chest source. Refused before opening with one expected denial and no ticket leak.
observations.furnace_regression: Opened the existing empty furnace and SDK-closed successfully. No item processing or transfer in this exact regression.
observations.form_regression: One SDK form action callback; zero outstanding form tickets.

counter_limit: Five Ender opens ended in three normal closes and two active denials. Three barrel opens and one furnace open closed normally. The wrong-family barrel refusal occurred before opening. SDK events do not certify every native transaction.
setup_observations: Two initial setblock keep commands refused while the chunk was unloaded before player join; no block was placed. After join, Ender test sources were created only in air. A barrel keep command refused an occupied location; another air location was used. No unrelated block was overwritten. Read-only clear commands always specified maxCount0; zero counts log no items to remove. One capture showed an unrelated notification and was excluded from public evidence.
not_qualified: Source-free or unrestricted remote Ender access
Custom storage policies or plugin-owned inventory writes
Source configuration migration for short aliases
All metadata combinations or stock client input profiles
Active distance/dimension transitions and source unload
Same-address source replacement by competing native code
Other storage layouts and full catalog on either platform
